title: pi-serena-lsp Tool Contracts
description: Shared JSON contract defining parameters for all Serena LSP tools exposed to the Pi coding agent. This file is the single source of truth for parameter types, required fields, and descriptions across the TypeScript and Python sides.

get_type.description: Resolve a name_path to its defining type symbol (interface, class, type alias, etc.) and return compact symbol information.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path to resolve to a type definition.

relative_path.description: Optional path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root, to scope the search.

find_symbol.description: Search Serena's LSP symbol index by name path pattern (component-by-component, right-to-left match).

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path pattern. Matched component-by-component, right-to-left, each component exact. Use leading / for absolute (exact full) match.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

code_snippet.description: Exact source code snippet to scope the search via rg. Only symbols whose location falls within a snippet occurrence are returned.

kinds.description: LSP SymbolKind names (e.g. 'Class', 'Method', 'Function') or integer values.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of symbol matches to return. Default 10. -1 means unlimited.

get_references.description: Find all references to a Serena symbol.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

get_implementations.description: Get implementations for a symbol using Serena's LSP backend when the active language server supports it.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

rename_symbol.description: Rename a symbol throughout the project using Serena's LSP refactoring.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

new_name.description: New symbol name. The language server may reject rename if the workspace has errors.

get_docstring.description: Get the hover text (documentation) for a symbol resolved via its name path.

name_path.description: Serena symbol name path for a named code entity in the symbol tree, for example MyClass/my_method or /MyClass/my_method.

relative_path.description: Path to a source file or directory, relative to the current project root.

restart_lsp.description: Restart the LSP language server processes for the current project. Kills all running language servers and re-initializes them fresh. Use when the LSP enters a bad state (stale index, crashed subprocess, resource exhaustion) or after editing .serenaproject.yml to pick up configuration changes.

cwd.description: Project root directory. The LSP re-initializes for this project.

get_document_overview.description: Get a two-section plain-text overview of a source file: Imports (what the file consumes) and Symbols (what the file defines, each with body line ranges).

relative_path.description: Path to a source file, relative to the current project root.

depth.description: Descendant nesting depth for the symbols tree. Default 0 (top-level only).

kinds.description: LSP SymbolKind names (e.g. 'Class', 'Method') or integer values to include. Defaults to structural kinds only: Module, Namespace, Class, Method, Constructor, Enum, Interface, Function, Struct, Event, TypeParameter. Pass an empty array to disable filtering.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of symbols to show. Default is unlimited (all symbols). When exceeded, symbols are truncated and '...' is appended to the Symbols section.
